facts.fact: BoFiNet reports its Digital Delta Data Centre in Botswana was awarded Uptime Institute Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility, confirmed on 23 October 2025, and says it serves customers and partners.

BWA.note: A government digital transformation agenda is mentioned, but no named strategy or its standing.
Uptime Institute certificate of one data centre is a company certificate and places nothing.
The document does not state who owns BoFiNet or that state data is hosted there.
